units.source_text: 大哥為我買下這一棟茅草屋，還為我僱了一位年近六旬、極其醜陋的紅髮女傭。

en.t: My elder brother bought this thatched cottage for me and also hired an extremely ugly red-haired maid who was nearly sixty.

units.source_text: 之後又過去了三年，在此期間，我多次遭到那位名叫徹子的老女傭奇怪的侵犯。

en.t: After that, another three years passed, and during that time I was repeatedly subjected to strange violations by the old maid named Tetsu.

units.source_text: 有時我們會像夫妻一樣吵架，我的肺病時好時壞，身體忽瘦忽胖，還伴隨有咳血痰。

en.t: At times we would quarrel like husband and wife, while my lung disease grew better and worse by turns, my body became thin and then fat, and I coughed up bloody phlegm.

units.source_text: 昨天，我讓徹子去村裡的藥店幫我買一盒卡爾莫欽，

en.t: Yesterday, I asked Tetsu to go to the village pharmacy and buy me a box of Calmotin,

units.source_text: 她買回來的盒子形狀與往常的不同，我也沒去特別留意，臨睡前一次服用了十粒，卻還是無法入睡。

en.t: The box she brought back was shaped differently from the usual one, but I paid no special attention to it, took ten tablets all at once before bed, and still could not sleep.
